extDescription.message: Shows which cookies a site and its trackers use. Nothing leaves your browser.

openSite.message: Open a website (http or https) and try again.

reloadToSee.message: Reload the page to see the trackers it contacts.

noRecognising.message: No third-party site can recognise you from this page.

recognising_one.message: $COUNT$ third-party site can recognise you from this page

recognising_other.message: $COUNT$ third-party sites can recognise you from this page

statMarketing.message: Marketing: $TOTAL$ ($SITE$ from the site, $TRACKERS$ from trackers)

statAnalytics.message: Analytics: $TOTAL$ ($SITE$ from the site, $TRACKERS$ from trackers)

noRequestData.message: No data about this page's requests.

footerNote.message: Tracker cookies are the ones the browser sends when the page contacts them. They may have been stored while visiting other sites: that is how a tracker recognises the same person everywhere.

groupNote_Identifier.message: Unknown to the database, but stored on another site's domain, sent to any site that contacts it (SameSite=None) and valid for at least $DAYS$ days: the typical shape of an identifier that follows a person across sites. It is a hint, not a classification.

choice_rejected.message: You rejected cookies on this site at $TIME$.

choice_accepted.message: You accepted cookies on this site at $TIME$.

choice_partial.message: You made a partial choice on this site at $TIME$.

choiceNone.message: No choice recorded on this site in this session.

choiceSourceTcf.message: Read from the site's consent platform (TCF standard).

choiceSourceClick.message: Detected from the button you clicked, “$LABEL$”: a less reliable method.

choiceTcfDetail.message: Purposes with consent: $CONSENTED$ of $TOTAL$. Still active on legitimate interest: $LEGITIMATE$.

afterRejectRecognising_one.message: After your rejection, $COUNT$ third-party site can recognise you from this page

afterRejectRecognising_other.message: After your rejection, $COUNT$ third-party sites can recognise you from this page

afterRejectNone.message: After your rejection, no third-party site can recognise you from this page.
